title: Plasma Computer Input-Output (Signature) — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Mirrors its public twin record: I/O is the plasma computer's skin: antennas, probes, windows, and pumps. The Signature extension builds the entire I/O ring as a field-port lattice: hundreds of microwave apertures that both launch and sense, software-switched between input and output. This is a Signature-concept extension (speculative): it is an original design proposal for the JAH system, never presented as established physics.

title: Plasma Computer Input-Output (Signature) — Analog-to-plasma and plasma-to-digital conversion
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Mirrors its public twin record: Conversion is modulation: bits become wave amplitude, phase, and frequency. The Signature extension uses soliton position modulation: the arrival time of a soliton in its window encodes extra bits, squeezing more data through each port. title: Plasma Computer Input-Output (Signature) — Contamination control at the boundary
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Mirrors its public twin record: Outgassing, sputtering, and pump oil are the enemies; bakeout and getters are the defense. The Signature extension adds a sacrificial plasma curtain at every port: incoming contaminants ionize in the curtain and are swept to a getter before reaching compute cells. This is a Signature-concept extension (speculative): it is an original design proposal for the JAH system, never presented as established physics.
